mechanism: Primidone is a potent CYP450 enzyme inducer that may reduce berberine bioavailability and efficacy through increased metabolism, while berberine may inhibit CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, potentially affecting primidone metabolism and increasing seizure breakthrough risk.
action: Monitor seizure control closely; consider berberine avoidance or adjust primidone dosing based on therapeutic drug monitoring; counsel patient on consistent dosing and seizure precautions.
